Name: SmartSprinkler
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29795/29795-1751682186-1355428404.gif[/img]

Description[/b]
[list]
[*]Makes sowing seeds and fertilizing easier.
[*]Simplifies tilling the soil around sprinklers.
[*]Makes harvesting crops more convenient.
[*]All actions also work with Garden Pots.
[*]While vanilla sprinklers don’t water Garden Pots, this mod allows them to.
[*]Enrichers will also function with Garden Pots.
[/list]
[b]How to Use[/b]
[list]
[*]Use a [b]Hoe[/b] on a sprinkler: Tills the soil within its effective range.
[*]Use [b]Seeds[/b] on a sprinkler: Plants seeds within its effective range.
[*]Use [b]Fertilizer[/b] on a sprinkler: Applies fertilizer within its effective range.
[*]Use a [b]Scythe[/b] on a sprinkler: Harvests crops within its effective range.
[*]Use a [b]Watering Can[/b] on a sprinkler: Waters crops within its effective range.
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b]
[list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]You can configure whether all fertilizers/seeds are applied at once to reduce the number of actions needed.
[*]If you feel that watering/hoeing without consuming stamina is unreasonable, you can enable "Consumes Stamina" in GMCM.
[/list]
